title: 第八章 沙盘推演
slug: 民国我包国维黄埔一期
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

来了一周的时间，黄埔的训练课程较为紧凑。

按照传统的军事教育理念，培养一个初级军官原本需要三年时间。但根据革命形势的紧迫需求，在不同时期有较大变化，总体上是缩短的、灵活的学制。

广州四面受敌，面临吴培福、孙川方等北洋军阀的威胁。还有个大威胁，省内退守在粤东的陈囧鸣。第一期学员实际毕业时间只用六个月。

一周的时间，包国维只觉得自己的进步速度飞跃。有着过目不忘之能，高强的模仿学习能力，十分高效。

之前黄埔总试的时候考了一百多名，有上辈子的记忆在，另外就是在浙江老家秦老太爷的书房看了小两个月的书，全记了下来，做足了准备。黄埔人才济济，即便如此，总试也在一百名开外。

黄埔内也有自己的图书馆，除了白天的课程之外，一到晚上，包国维就去了图书馆看书，直到就寝才回来，就算图书馆关灯了还借了几本书回了宿舍。

盖上了被子，打了个手电筒躲在被子里头看书，可不敢把过目不忘这个大外挂的能力给浪费了。

如此勤奋的事迹被舍友们知道了，一个个都赞叹的很。

更重要的一点是，包国维感觉自己的精神充沛，一天下来只要能睡上个三四个小时，第二天整个人的精气神都很不错，比常人睡七八个小时还要精神。种种迹象表明，身体素质这一块确实得到加强了。

如果现在再去志诚中学考试的话，体育考试成绩不仅仅是乙了，轻轻松松能拿个甲。

舍友起夜上厕所的时候发现包国维竟然还没睡，还在看书，小声说道：“国维，现在都几点了，明天还要上课呢，睡那么一会儿，这几天还天天如此，你不要命了。”

“我想多看会儿书，深感光阴流逝，想尽快多涨知识涨本领，报效家国。”

“随你了，多注意身体。”

盖上了被子，翻书页的声音格外的小，一般不会影响到他人。

黄埔校军的军服看着也格外帅气，几百人凑在一起，威风凛凛，仅仅一周的时间，面貌和刚入学的时候就有了更大的转变，其素养气质是当前的军阀部队完全不具备的。

陆军军官学校是培养军官培养军事人才的地方，军事指挥能力格外的重要，操场上有一个大沙盘，围着不少的人开始讨论了起来。

主要三批人，一批是像蒋羡耘这样加入了红党的人。一批是贺中韩这样的国党的人。更多是像包国维哪个党派都还没有参加的人。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After arriving for a week, Huangpu’s training sessions were relatively intensive.

According to traditional military education concepts, it originally takes three years to train a junior officer.However, according to the urgent needs of the revolutionary situation, there have been major changes in different periods. Generally speaking, the academic system is shortened and flexible.

Guangzhou was surrounded by enemies on all sides and faced threats from Beiyang warlords such as Wu Peifu and Sun Chuanfang.There is another big threat, Chen Juanming, who is retreating to eastern Guangdong in the province.The actual graduation time for the first batch of students is only six months.

Within a week, Bao Guowei felt that his progress had leapt.He has a photographic memory, strong imitation learning ability, and is very efficient.

I got more than 100 candidates in the Huangpu General Examination, and I still have memories from my previous life. In addition, I read two months of books in the study room of Mr. Qin in my hometown in Zhejiang. I memorized them all and was fully prepared.Huangpu is full of talented people, but even so, there are still only a hundred candidates for the general examination.

Huangpu also has its own library. In addition to classes during the day, Bao Guowei went to the library to read at night and did not come back until he went to bed. Even when the lights were turned off in the library, he borrowed a few books and returned to his dormitory.

I covered myself with a quilt, turned on a flashlight and hid under the quilt to read, not daring to waste my photographic memory on this great cheat.

Such diligent deeds were known to the roommates, and everyone was very impressed.

More importantly, Bao Guowei feels that he is energetic. As long as he can sleep for three or four hours at the end of the day, his energy and energy will be very good the next day, and he will be more energetic than ordinary people who sleep for seven or eight hours.There are various signs that physical fitness has indeed been strengthened.

If I go to Zhicheng Middle School to take the exam now, my physical education test score will not only be B, but I can easily get an A.

When his roommate got up to go to the bathroom at night, he found that Bao Guowei was still reading a book. He whispered: "Guowei, what time is it now? We have classes tomorrow. If you sleep for a while and it continues to be like this every day these days, you are going to die."

"I want to read more books. I deeply feel the passage of time. I want to increase my knowledge and skills as soon as possible to serve my country."

"It's up to you, pay more attention to your health."

Covered with a quilt, the sound of turning the pages of a book is extremely quiet, and usually does not affect others.

The military uniforms of the Huangpu School Army also look particularly handsome. Hundreds of people gathered together, looking majestic. In just one week, their appearance has changed even more than when they first entered school. Their quality and temperament are completely lacking in the current warlord troops.

The Army Officer School is a place where officers are trained and military talents are cultivated. Military command ability is particularly important. There is a large sand table on the playground, and many people gathered around it and began to discuss it.

There are three main groups of people. One group is people like Jiang Xianyun who joined the Red Party.One group is people from the Kuomintang like He Zhonghan.There are more people like Bao Guowei who have not joined any political party.
